summary: Your first day in Mumbai starts with a morning flight from Delhi. After arriving and settling in at your hotel in Juhu, you'll embark on an educational journey to the Nehru Science Centre and Planetarium in Worli. The day concludes with a relaxing dinner back in the vibrant Juhu area.
